mapper.sql: g.cd_grp_id AS "groupId", g.cd_grp_nm AS name, g.cd_grp_se_cd AS kind, g.attr1_nm AS "attr1Name", g.attr2_nm AS "attr2Name", g.attr3_nm AS "attr3Name", g.sort_seq AS "order", g.use_yn AS use, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM cmn.cd_dtl d WHERE d.cd_grp_id=g.cd_grp_id) AS "codeCount"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cmn.cd_grp g ORDER BY g.sort_seq , g.cd_grp_id
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.cd_grp
SELECT FROM cmn.cd_grp g WHERE g.cd_grp_id=#{group}
mapper.sql: dtl_cd AS code, cd_nm AS name, sort_seq AS "order", use_yn AS use, attr1_val AS attr1, attr2_val AS attr2, attr3_val AS attr3, aply_bgn_dt AS date
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} ORDER BY sort_seq , dtl_cd
SELECT FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} ORDER BY sort_seq, dtl_cd
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.cd_grp (cd_grp_id,cd_grp_nm,cd_grp_se_cd,sort_seq,attr1_nm,attr2_nm,attr3_nm,created_by) SELECT #{groupId},#{name},'BIZ',COALESCE(MAX(sort_seq),0)+1,#{attr1Name},#{attr2Name},#{attr3Name},NULL FROM cmn.cd_grp
mapper.update: UPDATE cmn.cd_dtl cd_nm=#{changes.cd_nm}, sort_seq=#{changes.sort_seq}, use_yn=#{changes.use_yn}, attr1_val=#{changes.attr1_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attr2_val=#{changes.attr2_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attr3_val=#{changes.attr3_val,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, aply_bgn_dt=#{changes.aply_bgn_dt,jdbcType=DATE}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} AND dtl_cd=#{code}
mapper.sql: m.map_id::text AS id,m.excel_lbl_nm AS label,m.trns_cd_grp_id AS "groupId",m.trns_cd AS code, g.cd_grp_nm AS "groupName",d.cd_nm AS "codeName",m.map_role_cd AS role,m.rmrk_desc AS memo,m.use_yn AS use
FROM cmn.excel_map m JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id JOIN cmn.cd_dtl d ON d.cd_grp_id=m.trns_cd_grp_id AND d.dtl_cd=m.trns_cd
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY m.excel_lbl_nm ,m.map_id
SELECT count(*)
SELECT WHERE m.map_id=#{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl d JOIN cmn.cd_grp g USING(cd_grp_id) WHERE cd_grp_id=#{group} AND dtl_cd=#{code} AND d.use_yn='Y' AND g.use_yn='Y')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.excel_map WHERE excel_lbl_nm=#{label} AND trns_cd_grp_id=#{groupId} AND trns_cd=#{code})
INSERT INTO cmn.excel_map(excel_lbl_nm,trns_cd_grp_id,trns_cd,map_role_cd,rmrk_desc,created_by) VALUES(#{label},#{groupId},#{code},#{role},#{memo},NULL) RETURNING map_id
mapper.update: UPDATE cmn.excel_map map_role_cd=#{changes.map_role_cd}, rmrk_desc=#{changes.rmrk_desc}, use_yn=#{changes.use_yn}, WHERE map_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT h.chg_at AS "changedAt",h.cd_grp_id AS "groupId", CASE WHEN h.cd_grp_id='PARAM' THEN '기준값' ELSE COALESCE(g.cd_grp_nm,h.cd_grp_id) END AS "groupName", h.dtl_cd AS code,h.cd_chg_ty_cd AS type,h.item_nm AS item,h.bfr_val AS before,h.aft_val AS after,h.chg_user_id AS "userId" FROM cmn.cd_hist h LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_grp g ON g.cd_grp_id=h.cd_grp_id ORDER BY h.chg_at ,h.cd_hist_id DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.cd_hist h
mapper.sql: oprt_std_id AS key,aply_bgn_ym AS month,oprt_std_nm AS name,num_val AS number, txt_val AS text,unit_nm AS unit,use_plc_desc AS usage
WHERE aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cmn.oprt_std newer WHERE newer.oprt_std_id=p.oprt_std_id AND newer.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} AND newer.aply_bgn_ym > p.aply_bgn_ym)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM cmn.oprt_std p ORDER BY oprt_std_id
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.oprt_std p
SELECT FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym
SELECT count(*) FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key}
SELECT ,oprt_std_desc AS description FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM cmn.oprt_std WHERE oprt_std_id=#{key} AND aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmn.oprt_std(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym,oprt_std_nm,num_val,txt_val,unit_nm,use_plc_desc,oprt_std_desc,created_by) VALUES(#{source.key},#{month},#{source.name},#{value.number},#{value.text},#{source.unit},#{source.usage},#{source.description},NULL) ON CONFLICT(oprt_std_id,aply_bgn_ym) DO UPDATE SET num_val=EXCLUDED.num_val,txt_val=EXCLUDED.txt_val
